messages:
Priya (partner-marketing): heads-up — CloudGate is going live in the marketplace next week. We have a short runway to lock launch post, a benchmark narrative, webinar slot, and inbound lead routing. Need quick sync on owners + timeline.

Eli (content): 👍 I can draft the launch post and benchmark narrative. Need numbers from eng for latency/cost comparisons and a customer quote. Deadline for draft?

Priya (partner-marketing): looking for a draft by Tue EOD so we can share with CloudGate for co-review Wed. Webinar target: Thurs 10 days after launch. CTA: demo signup + partner case study.

Jonas (growth): routing question — where do marketplace leads flow? We should map to a dedicated SFDC queue and tag them with partner=cloudgate. Also want a lightweight qualification flow so sales knows they're marketplace-sourced.

Priya (partner-marketing): yes — SFDC queue = "Marketplace - CloudGate". Tagging: partner=cloudgate, source=marketplace. Can you own webhook wiring?

Jonas (growth): I can. Quick snippet for the marketing devs to push to the listing page (hidden fields + webhook):
```
POST /webhooks/marketplace-leads
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "email": "{{email}}",
  "name": "{{name}}",
  "partner": "cloudgate",
  "source": "marketplace",
  "utm_campaign": "cloudgate-marketplace"
}
```

Eli (content): For the benchmark narrative — propose we show: 1) per-token cost comparison (quantized > other provider), 2) median p95 latency at 1k tokens, 3) inferred TCO for a 10k DAU job. Need eng numbers + a short snippet from a beta customer (can pull from customer success).

Priya (partner-marketing): Eng lead gave preliminary numbers in the private doc — I'll paste after this thread. Beta customer (AdeptApps) agreed to a short quote: "Switched for predictable latency during peak hours; reduced token spend by ~28%." Should be fine to use with partner sign-off.

Jonas (growth): For inbound routing in HubSpot/SFDC, I'll create a workflow: marketplace leads -> assign to Queue "Marketplace - CloudGate" -> add lead owner = regional SDR pool -> if demo requested AND company size >= 50 employees -> mark as MQL. Will send the mapping later.

Eli (content): Webinar outline idea (30-40m + Q&A): 1) welcome + product overview (Priya) 2) deep technical on latency/cost (eng) 3) customer case study (AdeptApps) 4) live demo + CTA. Need speaker list + 2 slides per section by Tue.

Priya (partner-marketing): Speakers: Priya, Rafael (eng lead), Maya (AdeptApps). Webinar assets: hero slide, 2 benchmark charts, 1 customer slide, registration form. I'll request partner co-brand assets today.

Jonas (growth): tiny ask on the registration form — add a checkbox: "Interested in a joint demo with CloudGate" so we can prioritize co-demo requests. Also add a hidden field `marketplace_listing_id=cloudgate_v1` for attribution.

Eli (content): For the launch post headline options (short list):
- "CloudGate + Redwood: Predictable low-latency inference in the CloudGate marketplace"
- "Lower token cost for production LLMs — CloudGate listing"
Pick one and I'll iterate.

Priya (partner-marketing): prefer the second for clarity. Also: timeline recap —
- Mon: final assets due (screenshots, logos, quote)
- Tue EOD: content draft + landing page copy
- Wed: partner review + finalize routing
- Thu: publish listing + post live social push
- Thu + 10 days: webinar

partner-bot: Reminder: Calendar slot created for Webinar Draft Review — Thu 09:00 PT. Invitees: Priya, Eli, Jonas, Rafael.

Eli (content): Action items I have: draft launch post + benchmark narrative (due Tue EOD), create webinar slide skeleton, request social snippets.

Jonas (growth): Action items I have: implement webhook payload, HubSpot mapping, SFDC queue creation, add hidden fields on reg form. ETA Wed EOD for wiring.

Priya (partner-marketing): I'll collect partner assets and confirm webinar speakers. Will post eng numbers and the final quote here by EOD today. Thanks team — let's keep the replies here so we have a single trail for partner review. :raised_hands:
